LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 2.1.1 CRITICAL LISTENING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: how can we ensure we gain the most out of a listening text? 2. why is it important to listen to key points in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. describe various forms of distractions to effective listening in different contexts,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. determine the speaker, context and intention in varied oral texts,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. select key points from an audio text for information,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the importance of critical listening in communication. ● in groups, learners are guided to brainstorm on different forms of distractions and how to avoid them, ● in groups, learners are guided to use digital devices with assistive technology to search for information online and offline on how to identify the speaker, context and intention, ● in groups, learners are guided to listen to a variety of audio texts and identify the speaker, context and intention, ● in groups, learners are guided to listen to a variety of texts on the theme while avoiding distractions, ● in groups, learners are guided to pick out the key points from an audio text and make notes. 1. how can we ensure we gain the most out of a listening text? 2. why is it important to listen to key points in a text? 18

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: The learner will generate new ideas as they brainstorm on different forms of distractions and

how to avoid them.

● Communication and collaboration: The learner will listen critically and show awareness of the speaker, context and

intention in varied oral texts.

Values:
● Responsibility: The learners engage in assigned duties and roles as they collaboratively use digital devices with assistive

technology to search for information online and offline on how to identify the speaker, context and intention.

● Love: The learner portrays a caring attitude as they brainstorm different forms of distractions and how to avoid them.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Environmental conservation: The learner’s awareness on climate change is heightened as they listen to texts on the theme and

pick out main points.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Print texts.

● Braille texts.

● Electronic reading materials.

● Digital devices with assistive technology.

● Audio visual clips.

Suggested Skills

● Describing various forms of distractions to effective listening in different contexts.

● Determining the speaker, context and intention in varied oral texts.

● Selecting key points from an audio text for information.
